result.description:
We are a newly established construction company based in regional Victoria. We provide comprehensive housing solutions, committed to delivering higher-quality, more affordable, and sustainable homes for families in rural Australia, as well as warehouses and commercial premises. Thanks to the trust of our existing clients, the company is growing and seeking a full-time Construction Estimator for our Mildura office.

About the position

•	Handle all building estimating tasks
•	Prepare quantity take-offs, BOQs, cost estimates, and tender submissions for residential and commercial projects.
•	 Review drawings, specifications, and project documentation to develop accurate pricing and budgets. 
•	Assess supplier and subcontractor quotations and prepare cost comparisons. 
•	Monitor project budgets, variations, and cost forecasts throughout project delivery. 
•	Identify cost risks, value engineering opportunities, and cost-saving initiatives. 
•	Assist in pricing HomeKit installation, smart home automation, drainage, renovation, and other building projects.
About you
•	At least two years of experience in residential estimating.
•	Experience in quantity take-offs, BOQ preparation, tender pricing, and cost estimation.
•	Strong understanding of construction methods, materials, and building documentation.
•	Experience reviewing supplier and subcontractor quotations and supporting procurement activities.
•	Ability to identify cost risks, pricing discrepancies, and cost-saving opportunities.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and estimating software.
•	Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple estimating tasks and deadlines.
•	Experience in residential and infrastructure projects will be highly regarded.
•	Previous site supervision or construction delivery experience will be highly regarded.
•	Mechanical engineering background or experience with equipment-based construction works will be highly regarded.

What we offer
•	Our leaders are here to support you and help you grow in your career
•	We offer flexible work options to suit your needs
•	Salary between $85,000 and $110,000 plus super, depending on your experience
result.title: Construction Estimator

result.description:
About Us
South East Queensland Hauliers (SEQH) is a leading provider of transport, logistics, and warehousing solutions throughout Queensland.
Proudly family-owned and operated since the 1960s, SEQH has grown into one of Australia's largest import and export wharf carriers. With operations spanning Brisbane, Toowoomba, and the Port of Brisbane, we continue to invest in our people, our facilities, and our future.
About the Role
As a Professional Diesel Mechanic/Fitter, you will play a crucial role in fault diagnosis, repair and maintenance of company vehicles and equipment. Your responsibilities will vary depending on your experience level but may include:
•	Minimising plant and equipment downtime through proactive maintenance.
•	Diagnosing, inspecting, servicing, and repairing the fleet to ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.
•	Maintaining all company plant, equipment, and vehicles according to manufacturer's specifications.
•	Attending breakdowns and performing field-related mechanical repairs promptly.
•	Communicating safety or maintenance issues effectively and efficiently.
About You
•	3 years' experience as a Diesel Mechanic/Fitter.
•	Certification III in Heavy Machine Mechanic or Diesel Fitter
•	Strong technical skills and knowledge of diesel engine systems and components
•	Experience with Kone, Kalmar, Hyster, Sennebogen, Caterpillar preferred
•	Manual Licence essential
What We Offer
•	Competitive full-time rates up to $55 per hour, with overtime opportunities.
•	Enjoy a local, family-friendly Monday to Friday roster.
•	Join a supportive and collaborative work environment.
•	Access training opportunities to support professional development.
•	Benefit from weekly pay and competitive remuneration.
Why Join SEQH?
At SEQH, we believe great people come from all backgrounds. We hire for attitude and invest in training, development, and career growth.
If you're looking for more than just a job and want the opportunity to build a long-term career in a growing industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Applications can be submitted via Seek or email at IWantacareer@seqh.com.au.
